versions.content: If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyRxData then SecOC shall immediately abort the reception via calling PduR_SecOCTpRxIndication with E_NOT_OK result, shall stop all internal actions related to the Secured I - PDU, and shall free all related buffers.

If the upper layer transport protocol module reports BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK in a call to PduR_SecOCTpCopyRxData then SecOC shall immediately abort the reception via calling PduR_SecOCTpRxIndication with E_NOT_OK result, shall stop all internal actions related to the Secured I - PDU, and shall free all related buffers.
